articles.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure

articles.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more

articles.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
articles.summary: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

articles.title: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
articles.summary: We asked Claude to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet. The prototypes worked without any fixes to their circuitry.
